label: Translation
description: Live-translate the UEFN Ducky UI into languages you add, using a chosen AI model. Strings are cached so each phrase is translated once.

steps.title: Languages tab
steps.body: Translation settings live here. Press the Languages tab to open them.

steps.title: Pick a model
steps.body: Click a model under Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, or Ollama. Empty / Default / Claude Code / Cursor cannot batch-translate.

steps.title: Add a language
steps.body: Type a language name (Spanish, Français, ja, …) and press Add. Adding only grows the list — it does not start translation.

steps.title: Your languages
steps.body: Click a language to select it. English (off) stops translation immediately.

steps.title: Press Start
steps.body: Translation never auto-starts from Add. After a language and an API model are picked, press Start.
